title: Grade 2 Science — Fri, May 22
description: Plants Around Us — Day 5 of 5: Synthesis — Plants and us
subject: science

questions.question: Match: Carrot → root, Spinach → leaf, Sugarcane → stem. Which row is WRONG?
questions.explanation: Cauliflower is a flower (not a fruit). The other three matches are correct.

questions.question: A plant makes its own food using sunlight, water, and ___. What is the third ingredient?
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis needs sunlight + water + carbon dioxide (CO₂ from air) → food (sugar) + oxygen.

questions.question: A child plants a mango seed and a mustard seed on the same day. Which will sprout first?
questions.explanation: Mustard (sarson) is a fast-growing plant that sprouts in days. Mango takes much longer. Smaller seeds often germinate faster.

questions.question: Plants give us oxygen when they make food. Why is this important for humans?
options: We use oxygen to decorate houses
We breathe oxygen to stay alive
questions.explanation: Humans and animals breathe in oxygen to survive. Plants produce oxygen as a by-product of photosynthesis, keeping our air breathable.

questions.question: Which of these shows a complete life cycle of a plant in the right order?
options: Seed → Germination → Seedling → Plant → Flower → Fruit → Seed
questions.explanation: Correct life cycle: Seed → Germination → Seedling → Adult plant → Flower → Fruit → Seed (new cycle begins).

questions.question: If all the trees in a forest were cut down, what would happen?
options: Animals would lose homes, soil would erode, and oxygen levels would drop
questions.explanation: Deforestation causes habitat loss, soil erosion (roots hold soil), reduced rainfall, and lower oxygen levels. Trees are essential.

questions.question: Seema eats rice, spinach, and mango for lunch. Which plant parts is she eating?
questions.explanation: Rice = seed, spinach = leaf, mango = fruit. She is eating three different parts of three different plants.

questions.question: Why do farmers water their fields even during summer?
options: Because plants need water to grow and make food
To prevent seeds from flying away
questions.explanation: Plants need water for photosynthesis (making food), carrying nutrients, and staying firm. Without water they wilt and die.

questions.question: A cactus survives in the desert but a water lily cannot. Why?
options: Cactus stores water in its thick stem; water lily needs to be in water
questions.explanation: Plants are adapted to their environment. Cactus can store water and has spines (not leaves) to reduce water loss. Water lily needs constant water.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a use of plants for humans?
questions.explanation: Plants give us food, medicine (neem, tulsi), clothes (cotton), wood, paper, and clean air. But plants do not directly make electricity for us.

questions.question: The roots of trees help in preventing:
options: Soil erosion — roots hold the soil in place
questions.explanation: Tree roots bind the soil together. Without trees, rain and wind wash and blow soil away — this is called soil erosion.

questions.question: If a plant is kept in a dark room for many days, what will happen?
options: It will turn yellow and weaken because it cannot make food without light
questions.explanation: Without sunlight, a plant cannot make food (no photosynthesis). It turns yellow (chlorophyll breaks down) and eventually dies.

questions.question: How are trees and herbs similar?
options: They are both the same size
Both are plants, both make their own food, both have roots, stem, and leaves
Both live for only one year
Both are used for medicine only
questions.explanation: Despite size differences, all plants share the same basic structure (roots, stem, leaves) and all make their own food through photosynthesis.

questions.question: A student plants a seed in a closed box with no water. What will happen?
options: The seed will not germinate because it needs water
The seed will germinate but die quickly
questions.explanation: Seeds need water to start germination. Without water the seed coat stays hard and the seed cannot sprout.

questions.question: Week summary: Name four parts of a plant and what each does.
options: Root (absorbs water), Stem (supports and carries water), Leaf (makes food), Flower (reproduction)
Root (makes food), Stem (absorbs water), Leaf (supports), Flower (gives colour only)
Root (makes flower), Stem (makes food), Leaf (absorbs water), Flower (none)
All parts do the same job
questions.explanation: Root: absorbs water and minerals. Stem: supports plant and carries water to leaves. Leaf: makes food using sunlight (photosynthesis). Flower: reproduction, leads to fruit and seeds.
